newsitem.title: PERU: Telefonica places 80 mln soles of short-term bonds.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica places 80 mln soles of short-term bonds.

text.p: Peruvian telecommunications firm and local bolsa benchmark, Telefonica del Peru, said Friday it had successfully placed all 80 million soles of short-term bonds offered in a local issue.
A Telefnica official said the company received total bids of 192 million soles in Thursday's sale, which was part of an ongoing global debt issue of up to $180 million.

The official said Telefnica placed 20 million soles of 30-day bonds at an average annual rate of 14.49 percent, 20 million soles at 60 days at 14.35 percent, 13.5 million soles at 90 days at 14.32 percent and 26.5 million soles at 360 days at 14.50 percent.
The money raised is intended for expansion and renovation work. The firm is controlled by Telefnica de Espaa.
